components.name: Wordmark
components.summary: The gathr logo: gathr. in Plus Jakarta Sans Bold (option J76), converted to vector outlines, with one true circle after the r.

components.name: Icon
components.summary: Lucide outline icons at a 1.75 stroke.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Flat pill buttons: no sheen, gradient or glow.

components.name: IconButton
components.summary: A round 48px icon button, like the search and heart buttons in the music-app reference.

components.name: Chip
components.summary: Filter chips: filled dark pills that turn violet when selected.

components.name: SearchField
components.summary: A glass search pill.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: Short UPPERCASE status labels.

components.name: CrowdMeter
components.summary: The crowd indicator: how busy a place is, in human words.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: A person's display picture in a circle, or their initials on a neutral disc when they haven't added one.

components.name: FriendsGoing
components.summary: A stack of friends' display pictures and a pink count of friends going.

components.name: ProgressBar
components.summary: The onboarding progress line: a white fill on a dark pill track.

components.name: PageIndicator
components.summary: Thin segments under a hero carousel.

components.name: Bloom
components.summary: The gathr gradient, kept for occasions.

components.name: TopBar
components.summary: The screen header: an avatar, wordmark or back button on the left and round glass buttons on the right.

components.name: TabBar
components.summary: The floating glass tab bar: five icons in a frosted pill that floats space-4 above the safe area.

components.name: Sheet
components.summary: A bottom sheet in strong glass, used for venue previews from the map, filters and quick actions.

components.name: VenueHero
components.summary: The venue detail header.

components.name: VenueCard
components.summary: The core card: a photo with glass overlays (live badge, save and crowd), then solid details below.

components.name: FeatureCard
components.summary: The hero card at the top of a feed, used for tonight's pick or a curated collection.

components.name: RankCard
components.summary: A ranked card with a giant ghost numeral, from the App Store "Top played" reference.

components.name: EventCard
components.summary: An image-first card for carousels.

components.name: EventRow
components.summary: A listing row with a rounded thumbnail, title, meta and a status badge or chevron button.

components.name: MapPin
components.summary: A venue on the dark map, as a sticker pin: a neutral rounded tile with the venue's 3D sticker popping out of it, a small tail, and a dark label with the venue…

components.name: VibeTag
components.summary: A speech-bubble sticker from the onboarding screen ("guestlists", "sundowners", "goodtime").

components.name: PhotoFrame
components.summary: A collage photo with a 3px white edge, a radius-md corner and a slight tilt, for onboarding and social collages.

components.name: ShapeAvatar
components.summary: A person or DJ cut into a playful shape (circle, arch, flower or pill) on a colour field, from the "Featured members" reference.

components.name: PillChain
components.summary: Event info as a chain of pills, from the festival-poster reference: name, date, arrow, time and venue, with an "echo" of fading circles.

components.name: StatBubbles
components.summary: Numbers as circles sized by value, from the bubble data-viz reference.

components.name: DotGrid
components.summary: A 10 × 10 waffle of dots showing one percentage, with a big numeral.

components.name: SocialSlide
components.summary: The Instagram and Threads carousel template, authored at 1080 × 1350 (or 1080 × 1920 for stories) and scaled for preview.

components.name: EventPoster
components.summary: The event poster at A-series proportion (1080 × 1527 on screen, or A3/A2 in print).

components.name: SiteHeader
components.summary: The website's top bar: a floating glass pill with the wordmark, up to three links and one white CTA.
